atoms.a: Each of Jessie’s friends tell her how tall they are in different units. Convert all their heights into centimetres.

instruction.text: Jessie wants to know the total height of all her friends. Add together the heights.

atoms.b: If you add up their heights, his friends are <mat><gap>1057</gap></mat>cm tall.

atoms.a: The Nürburgring Grand Prix track is <mat>5148</mat> m long. When they race, the drivers must drive 60 laps. How many kilometres do the drivers travel per race?
atoms.sound: The Nürburgring Grand Prix track is 5,148 metres long. When they race, the drivers must drive 60 laps. How many kilometres do the drivers travel per race?

hint.text: Don’t forget to convert to kilometres!

atoms.b: The drivers travel <mat><gap>308.88</gap></mat> km per race.
